jobs.title: Graduate Software Developers
jobs.description:
**Location:** Edinburgh and Bristol  
**Salary:** £36,000 per annum

*We maintain a flexible working policy to allow for hybrid working when appropriate. Teams typically spend around 60% of their time in the office, although this may vary depending on project and business needs.*

If you are an engineering graduate who has recently graduated, or is due to graduate next year, we would love to hear from you. We have exciting opportunities for 5 Software Developer graduates to launch their career within a world-leading technology company developing advanced software solutions for uncrewed maritime systems. You can be based in either our Edinburgh or Bristol office.

Working as part of a collaborative engineering project team, you will contribute to the design, development, testing and integration of innovative software solutions that are deployed by customers across the globe. You will be supported through structured development, training and mentoring to help you grow into a highly capable software engineering professional.

**Why Join SeeByte?**

This is a unique opportunity to join a world-respected company operating at the forefront of autonomous and robotic technologies. You will work alongside experienced engineers, researchers and technical specialists while contributing to software solutions that solve complex real-world challenges.

SeeByte offers an environment where you can develop your technical expertise, build meaningful industry experience and benefit from clear career progression opportunities within a supportive and innovative culture.

For more information about life at SeeByte, our employee benefits, culture and recruitment process, please visit our Career Site

**Main Purpose of the Role**

As a Graduate Software Developer, you will contribute throughout the software development lifecycle, helping to transform customer requirements into high-quality solutions while developing your technical expertise and gaining experience across a range of technologies and projects. Substantial support, training and development will be provided to enable you to grow within the role and build a successful career in software engineering.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, implement, test and deliver robust C# software solutions.
* Contribute to software design, development, testing and integration activities across engineering projects.
* Deliver work to a high standard while proactively identifying opportunities for software improvement.
* Work with colleagues to understand, analyse and break down customer and project requirements.
* Collaborate effectively with engineers, technical specialists and external stakeholders.
* Participate in code reviews, testing activities and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Develop knowledge of modern software engineering practices, tools and technologies.

**Key Skills, Experience and Qualifications:**

* Degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science or a related discipline, or working towards gaining a degree in a relevant discipline in 2027.
* Ideally a focus on developing software using C# gained through academic, personal or commercial projects, though a background in other programming languages would also be suitable (Java, Kotlin, TypeScript)
* Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
* Good interpersonal and communication skills.
* Ability to work effectively as part of a collaborative team.
* Enthusiasm for learning new technologies and developing technical skills.
* Eligible to apply for UK Security Clearance.

**Desirable:**

* Knowledge of modern C# language features.
* Experience of XAML-based Windows UI development, ideally WPF.
* Understanding of software verification and deployment techniques.
* Familiarity with defect tracking and collaboration tools such as GitLab or Jira.
* Knowledge of Continuous Delivery frameworks such as Jenkins.

**You Will Stand Out If You:**

* **Deliver Results**: Are focused on delivering excellent outcomes for customers.
* **Collaborate**: Communicate clearly, respectfully and effectively with colleagues and stakeholders.
* Actively contribute to a positive, collaborative and inclusive team culture.
* Enjoy sharing knowledge and supporting others.
* **Adaptive Thinking**: Demonstrate curiosity, initiative and a genuine passion for learning.
* Take ownership of your development and seek opportunities to expand your skills and experience.

At SeeByte, we are committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace and supporting employee wellbeing. If you require any adjustments or accessibility support during the recruitment process, please reach out to people@seebyte.com

**Because of the nature of the work associated with this post it is subject to special nationality rules and is open only to the following nationalities since birth: British, EE, Switzerland, Iceland Norway, Albania, North Macedonia, Montenegro, Australia, New Zealand, Canada and Japan. Due to government security restrictions dual nationality can only be considered within this list of countries**

**All offers of employment will be conditional upon successful completion of a Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS) process and may require security clearance depending on project requirements.**

**As part of this process, SeeByte collects personal data as defined under UK GDPR, including proof of identity, nationality and immigration status, right to work in the UK, employment and/or academic references, and Basic Disclosure information relating to unspent criminal convictions. Please refer to our Privacy Notice for further information.**

**No recruitment agencies.**

jobs.title: Web Developer Intern
jobs.description:
**Overview**

Join our innovative team as a Web Developer Intern and dive into the dynamic world of web application development! This paid internship offers an exciting opportunity to gain hands-on experience in building responsive, user-friendly websites and web services. You'll collaborate with seasoned developers to enhance your skills in front-end and back-end technologies, contributing to real projects that make a difference. If you're passionate about coding, eager to learn, and ready to develop your career in software development, this is the perfect role for you!

**Duties**

* Assist in designing and developing engaging, responsive web interfaces using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and frameworks like React, Angular, or Vue.js.
* Support back-end development tasks with technologies such as Node.js, Django, ASP.NET Core, or Ruby on Rails to create robust web services and APIs.
* Collaborate on database management and integration using MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, or SQL Server to ensure efficient data storage and retrieval.
* Contribute to version control workflows utilizing GitHub, Git, SVN, or Jenkins for seamless code management and deployment.
* Participate in wireframing and UX/UI design processes to craft intuitive user experiences that align with project goals.
* Assist in testing applications through unit testing and debugging to ensure high-quality deliverables.
* Support DevOps practices by working with Docker containers, AWS cloud services, Ansible automation tools, and continuous integration pipelines.

**Qualifications**

* Currently pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Web Development or a related field.
* Demonstrated knowledge of front-end technologies including HTML5, CSS3 (SCSS/SASS), JavaScript (TypeScript), AJAX, Bootstrap, and responsive web design principles.
* Familiarity with back-end frameworks such as Node.js, Django,.NET (C#), or PHP for server-side development.
* Experience with databases like MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB or SQL Server; understanding of SQL queries and data visualization techniques.
* Knowledge of version control systems including Git or SVN; experience with CI/CD tools like Jenkins is a plus.
* Basic understanding of RESTful APIs and web services; exposure to GraphQL or SOAP is advantageous.
* Ability to work collaboratively within Agile methodologies such as Scrum or Kanban using tools like Jira or Trello.
* Strong problem-solving skills with attention to detail; eager to learn new technologies like AWS cloud platform or DevOps practices.

Embark on this journey with us and develop your skills while contributing to impactful web projects! This internship not only enhances your technical expertise but also immerses you in a vibrant team environment dedicated to innovation and growth.

Pay: £5.00-£10.00 per year

Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Fullstack Developer with a focus on React (and some C#/.NET)
jobs.description:
We're looking for someone with a few years of experience in React who also enjoys stepping into the backend when needed. The role is roughly 80% frontend and 20% backend, so you'll spend most of your time building sleek, fast and user-friendly interfaces, while also being comfortable working in C#/.NET. You like using AI tools in your daily work to work faster and smarter.  
You don't need to tick every box below. If most of it fits you and you're curious about the rest, apply!

**WHO ARE YOU?**  
You're a social person who thrives in a team and enjoys collaborating. You like taking responsibility, can lead and structure the work, and help the team stay on course.

**TECH AND SKILLS**  
React  
C# / .NET

**NICE TO HAVE**  
Experience with AI-assisted development (e.g. Claude Code, Cursor or GitHub Copilot)  
Experience with Azure

**EXPERIENCE**  
A few years of experience in software development in a team, with an emphasis on frontend

**Location:** Gothenburg, you work on-site at the office 5 days a week
  
**Start:** Immediately  
  
**ABOUT US**

Logikfabriken is a consultancy by and for talented, engaged and fun people in tech. Our ambition is to become Sweden's best and most inspiring employer. Together we create the conditions and drive the company forward.

We value spending time together, which is why we go on two conferences a year and organize talks, after-works and lots of other fun things. On top of that, we believe in fair pay and transparency. That's why everyone at Logikfabriken has the same terms and sets their own salary, pension, parental pay, number of vacation days and other benefits.

Our model is flexible, secure and in most cases means a substantial pay increase. See for yourself what you could earn: Calculate your salary: https://salary.logikfabriken.com/

We also care a lot about sustainability. Logikfabriken has been climate neutral since 2017 and we're constantly working to reduce our footprint. Find our full offer here: Logikfabriken FAQ: https://jobs.logikfabriken.se/posts?tag=FAQ
